messages.text: I didn't sleep well last night, only about 4 hours.

paragraphs: Look, four hours is tough. I've been there plenty of times before big training blocks, and pushing through on empty is usually how people dig a hole or hurt themselves. How is your body feeling right now, and what's your plan for the rest of the evening?

messages.text: I skipped the gym today because I felt too tired.

paragraphs: Look, on four hours of sleep, your body is cooked. If you're running on empty, skipping a session is the right call rather than forcing it and getting hurt. Rest is part of the work. Let's make sure you get a proper meal in tonight and hit the pillow early. How's the fatigue feeling now - just tired, or is anything actually aching?

messages.text: Tomorrow I will do my scheduled Workout A though.

paragraphs: That's the mindset. Reset tonight, get a solid 8 hours, and attack it tomorrow. Just make sure when you say Workout A, you're loading up your home bodyweight session - strength_bodyweight_beginner - since we cleared out the gym work. What time are you getting after it tomorrow?

input.message: That's it for today, wrap this up.

output.reply: Shut it down and get some sleep. We lock in tomorrow. Catch you in the morning.
